description: Réseau de bornes de recharge pour du syndicat départemental d'énergie des Hautes-Pyrénées (SDE65) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by serge CIEUTAT. network of public charging stations installed by the Hautes-Pyrénées departmental energy union (SDE65) on the Hautes-Pyrénées department. Coverage: serge CIEUTAT. The portal shows the English title as "Network of charging stations for electric vehicles of the Hautes-Pyrénées departmental energy union (SDE65)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is serge CIEUTAT. Its keywords include mobilite-transport, transport, vehicule-electrique, vehicules, bornes-de-recharge, irve. The listing shows 2023-08-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
